name: Twin City Plaza
summary: Twin City Plaza is a large outdoor community shopping center in Somerville, MA, featuring a supermarket, pharmacy, retail shops, healthcare providers, and fast-food restaurants. Professionally managed by Regency Centers, this well-rated destination serves as a convenient one-stop shopping location for the Greater Boston area.
demographics: Twin City Plaza serves a diverse urban population in Somerville, Massachusetts, drawing from the densely populated Greater Boston area. The primary trade area includes young professionals, families, and students with a mix of income levels, reflecting Somerville's transformation from a working-class community to a more affluent, educated demographic. Shoppers are typically convenience-focused, seeking everyday necessities from the supermarket and pharmacy, along with quick-service dining options. The center attracts a high percentage of walkable traffic and public transit users given its urban location along McGrath Highway.
description: Twin City Plaza is a well-established community shopping center strategically located at 14-22 McGrath Highway in Somerville, Massachusetts, serving the Greater Boston metropolitan area. This large outdoor shopping destination has become a neighborhood staple, offering residents convenient access to essential services and everyday shopping needs. The center features a diverse tenant mix anchored by a full-service supermarket and pharmacy, complemented by various retail shops, healthcare providers, and popular fast-food restaurants. Managed by Regency Centers, a nationally recognized shopping center developer and operator, Twin City Plaza benefits from professional management and ongoing investment in the property. With operating hours from 6:00 AM to 11:00 PM and a strong 4.2-star rating from over 3,000 reviews, the center has earned its reputation as a reliable and accessible shopping destination for the Somerville community and surrounding areas.
